parsed.name: 原始数据写盘组件
parsed.description: 非物理软件组件，用于在实验采集过程中异步将原始数据流写入磁盘文件，以尽量降低对 UDP 接收可靠性的影响。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component for asynchronously writing raw data streams to disk files during experimental acquisition, helping minimize impact on UDP reception reliability.

actions.description: 创建并打开指定路径和文件名的原始数据文件，用于后续写入。
actions.description_en: Create and open a raw data file at the specified path and filename for subsequent writing.

actions.description: 关闭当前正在写入的文件。
actions.description_en: Close the file currently being written.

actions.description: 将提供的缓冲区原始数据写入当前文件。
actions.description_en: Write the provided raw buffer data to the current file.
